div.div: SystemSensors · ProcessSource · FileLocks · StartupItems · CounterSource · PowerActions · IdleSignals, among 16, plus WakeScheduler and WolReader. Contract: no panics, Unavailable with a reason, bounded calls, a start-time check on every ProcessRef. PowerActions (sleep, hibernate, shut down) and WakeScheduler (scheduled wakes) ask the OS to act, as the owner set them up.

text.tspan: SystemSensors · ProcessSource · FileLocks · StartupItems · CounterSource · PowerActions · IdleSignals, among 16, plus WakeScheduler and WolReader. Contract: no panics, Unavailable with a reason, bounded calls, a start-time
check on every ProcessRef. PowerActions (sleep, hibernate, shut down) and WakeScheduler (scheduled wakes) ask the OS to act, as the owner set them up.
